title: #58 Tony Bardy, HWR Motorsport Vauxhall Belmont, BTCC 1991
wheel_note: Gold 5-spoke with a deep polished lip, zoomed on Getty LAT 2201201054 (both left-side wheels, on track); the lip is wider than the tool draws it.
note: Same HWR Motorsport car as Wilson's (round 12 Thruxton entry, did not start): the Autosport Nostalgia Forum '1991 BTCC' thread calls it 'Rallycrosser Tony Bardy's outing in the Wilson Belmont' (https://forums.autosport.com/topic/106464-1991-btcc/), and the BBC grid drawing for round 12 (A_grid_r12_thruxton_b_10) shows a white Belmont with the board on the front door and the dark band on the rear quarter, which fits. Drawn with Bardy's name on the window; his name lettering on the car is not seen in any reference, and the forum is not sure he kept #58. Livery as 58_wilson (TouringCarTimes photo and Getty LAT 2201201054, both right side, mirrored), moved onto the redrawn Belmont body (Nov 2026). Logos (2026-11-16): CHAMPION on the front wing and the Vauxhall griffin, VAUXHALL and Mobil 1 on the small rear door sticker are now the real logos (Getty LAT 2201201054 and the TouringCarTimes photo, right side, mirrored). Bristol Street / SUNDERLAND No.1 stays drawn (no logo file exists), and both DUNLOPs stay lettering (the Dunlop file has the flying D, the bumper decals show only the word). The small text line on the Vauxhall sticker is unreadable and left out. Bardy's car is drawn as Wilson's, so all of this is assumed. 2026-11-16: first left-side view found: supertouring.co.uk 1991 entrants gallery page 5, 'belmont_91.jpg' (https://web.archive.org/web/2012/http://www.supertouring.co.uk/gallery/1991_entrants_5.html, 230x160, front 3/4, Wilson's #58, saved in teams/_series/ask_permission/on_track). It confirms the mirrored layout (ESSO header and 58 at the front of the front door, a dark blue box at the top of the rear quarter) but is too small and foreshortened to measure anything new; no livery change. Peter Still's 1991 album (stillphotography.co.uk, album04: btcc91_30 'Jeff Wilson tried the Vauxhall Belmont at Silverstone', btcc91_31/32 the round 15 crash) has only btcc91_32 archived (car upside down, saved). 2026-11-17: moved onto the new hand-traced Belmont outline (model_refs/belmont_hand.py, traced on a user-supplied near side-on race photo of Wilson's #58, right side, mirrored) by landmarks (model_refs/belmont_remap.py); ESSO board and the Vauxhall/Mobil 1 sticker set just behind their shut lines as on that photo, all other decals checked on it. That photo also shows a Valvoline sticker low on the rear door and gold dish wheels: the same date-dependent look as the TouringCarTimes photo, so both stay as decided above (no Valvoline, 5-spoke wheels). 2026-11-17 (later): the Belmont outline was redrawn (model_refs/belmont_hand2.py, on the #58 photo and a user-supplied near side-on SRi photo); decals re-checked on the #58 photo in the new frame, only the two DUNLOP bumper stickers moved (model_refs/belmont_remap2.py).
